raw_response_text: {"consideration_assertions":[],"consideration_mechanics":[{"surface":"EXCHANGE_MECHANICS","quote":"If any Certificate shall have been lost, stolen or destroyed, upon the making of an affidavit of that fact by the Person claiming such Certificate to be lost, stolen or destroyed and, if required by Parent, the First Surviving Corporation or the Surviving Company, the posting by such Person of a bond, in such reasonable amount as the First Surviving Corporation or the Surviving Company may direct, as indemnity against any claim that may be made against it with respect to such Certificate, the Exchange Agent shall, if such holder has otherwise delivered a properly completed and duly executed letter of transmittal, issue in exchange for such lost, stolen or destroyed Certificate the Merger Consideration to be paid in respect of the shares of Company Common Stock represented by such Certificate as contemplated by this Article II.","detail":"Lost, stolen or destroyed Certificates may be exchanged for Merger Consideration after the stated affidavit, bond if required, and letter of transmittal.","alternatives":[],"election_choice":null,"cash_alternatives":[],"stock_alternatives":[],"default_treatment":null,"cash_cap":null,"equity_cap":null,"proration_numerator":null,"proration_denominator":null}],"open_world_candidates":[]}
